regime_read: Convergence is concentrated in AI compute, memory and cloud platforms, with NVDA showing the broadest independent alignment and MU/MSFT offering cleaner second-order exposure. Signals remain provisional because the desk has no scored history, while social sentiment, affiliations and lobbying are supporting rather than decisive evidence.
regime_read_zh: 当前信号主要集中于AI算力、存储和云平台，其中NVDA的独立信号共振最广，MU与MSFT则提供较清晰的二阶敞口。由于该策略尚无已评分记录，所有判断仍属初步；社交情绪、关联关系和游说活动只能作为辅助证据。

theses.thesis: The pack's strongest convergence combines institutional adding, dark-pool accumulation, analyst upgrades, developer momentum and a large patent cluster [13f_add] [darkpool_accum] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster]. Disclosed holdings by Nancy Pelosi, Marjorie Taylor Greene and Michael McCaul add an influence-graph confirmation, although they do not establish causality [actor:Nancy Pelosi] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Michael McCaul]. The shares are not extended versus SPY, so the entry constraint does not block an overweight; earnings in 20 days create event risk as well as a validation point [earnings_metric].
theses.thesis_zh: 证据包中最强的共振来自机构增持、暗池吸筹、分析师集中上调、开发者动能和大型专利集群 [13f_add] [darkpool_accum] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster]。Nancy Pelosi、Marjorie Taylor Greene和Michael McCaul披露持仓，为影响力图提供额外印证，但不代表因果关系 [actor:Nancy Pelosi] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Michael McCaul]。相对SPY并未处于过度延伸状态，因此可采取增持倾向；20个交易日后的财报既是风险事件，也是验证节点 [earnings_metric]。
second_order: MU — AI-compute deployment implies greater demand for memory capacity.
LITE — continued data-center scaling can support optical-connectivity demand.
AI power and data-center infrastructure — compute deployment requires additional power, cooling and physical capacity.
theses.dissent: Retail buzz and analyst agreement may reflect an already crowded consensus, while the upcoming earnings event can overwhelm slower-moving alternative-data signals.

falsifier.text: Dark-pool accumulation reverses and the next earnings update fails to sustain the demand narrative.

theses.thesis: BA shows a modest but diversified alignment across government-grant acceleration, insider purchase intensity and patent activity [gov_grant] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster]. Pending FY2027 defense authorization activity provides a broad sector backdrop, although the pack does not tie the legislation directly to BA [bill:HRES1438]. Jim Cramer's endorsement and bullish social sentiment are weak supporting signals only [actor:Jim Cramer] [stocktwits_bull].
theses.thesis_zh: BA呈现温和但相对多元的共振，包括政府补助加速、内部人买入指标和专利活动 [gov_grant] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster]。待推进的2027财年国防授权事项构成广义行业背景，但证据包并未将该法案直接关联至BA [bill:HRES1438]。Jim Cramer的背书及看多社交情绪只能视为较弱的辅助信号 [actor:Jim Cramer] [stocktwits_bull]。
second_order: Aerospace-supplier theme — improving production or program activity would flow through the component supply chain.
Defense-electronics theme — FY2027 defense activity may support adjacent program suppliers.
Advanced-manufacturing theme — BA's patent activity implies ongoing demand for specialized engineering inputs.
theses.dissent: The government-grant signal is small relative to BA's scale, and neither broad defense legislation nor social optimism proves improved execution.

falsifier.text: Grant acceleration fades and insider buying is not followed by evidence of better program execution.
